title: Fact or Fiction: Is Jesus History?
planCorrection: All trust choices should lead to second watch segment.
prompt: Create a fresh English journey called “Fact or Fiction: Is Jesus History?” for someone curious or skeptical about whether Jesus was real and whether the Gospel accounts are trustworthy. Keep it welcoming and thoughtful, with short copy, dark cards, a quick response about whether they trust the story, a brief historical-evidence reflection, and a closing question about who they think Jesus was. Use the seeded Jesus Film library video “Fact or Fiction” in English throughout: a short muted background segment beginning around 11 seconds on the welcome, then two separate full-screen watch cards at different points in the journey, playing 0–133 seconds and 134–306 seconds of that same film. Put the trust question between the two watch cards and the final identity question after the evidence reflection. Show as much of the video as possible rather than cropping it. Make the choices and Continue buttons connect the journey naturally. No external links, sign-ups or contact collection.
